page.overview:
Who is Hooman?

"Hooman started off his career in the news as a "go for." The reporters and producers didn't even know his real name, they simply called him "Gofor," as they sent him off to go for lunch, go for equipment, or go for anything else they needed. But nowadays all he goes for are the big stories, and everybody knows who Hooman is."
